item.title: 苹果发布 M6 MacBook Pro 和 iMac
item.guid: 苹果发布-M6-MacBook-Pro-和-iMac
item.description:
Apple has released MacBook Pro and iMac models equipped with the M6 chip, with starting prices in mainland China of 15,999 yuan and 12,499 yuan, respectively. 苹果发布搭载 M6 芯片的 MacBook Pro 和 iMac，国行起售价 分别为 15999 元、12499 元。

The M6 features a 12-core CPU and a 12-core GPU, an increase of 2 cores each compared to the M5. Each GPU core includes a neural accelerator and is equipped with a dual 16-core neural engine. Apple states that compared to the M5, graphics performance is boosted by up to 30%, and on-device AI workload performance is improved by up to 25%. M6 配备 12 核 CPU 和 12 核 GPU，相比 M5 各增加 2 核，GPU 每个核心均带有神经网络加速器，并配备双 16 核神经网络引擎。苹果称，相比 M5，图形性能最高提升 30%，端侧 AI 工作负载性能最高提升 25%。

The MacBook Pro comes standard with 16GB of unified memory, with an option for up to 32GB, and a memory bandwidth of 170GB/s. MacBook Pro 标配 16GB 统一内存，最高可选 32GB，内存带宽为 170GB/s。

The iMac's design continues the 24-inch all-in-one form factor, offering seven color options: blue, green, pink, yellow, purple, orange, and silver. It features a 4.5K Retina display; it can be equipped with up to 4 Thunderbolt 4 ports and supports up to 2 external 6K displays. iMac 外观则延续 24 英寸一体机设计，提供蓝、绿、粉、黄、紫、橙、银七种配色，配备 4.5K 视网膜显示屏；最高配备 4 个雷雳 4 端口，并支持最多 2 台 6K 外接显示器。

item.title: iPhone 18 Pro 上市三周在华销量增 29%，美国与日本下滑
item.guid: iPhone-18-Pro-上市三周在华销量增-29%，美国与日本下滑
item.description:
Counterpoint Research's weekly sales tracker, released on October 27, shows that global sales of the iPhone 18 Pro series in its first three weeks on the market increased by 3.1% compared to the same period for the previous generation. The main growth came from the Chinese market, where sales increased by 29% year-on-year, while the US and Japanese markets both saw declines. Counterpoint Research 10 月 27 日公布的周度销量追踪显示，iPhone 18 Pro 系列上市前三周的全球销量较上一代同期增长 3.1%，主要增量来自中国市场：在华销量同比增长 29%，美国、日本市场则均出现下滑。

The agency believes that the Chinese market benefited from improved supply in the initial launch period and price increases for competing Android flagship models. US consumers had a weaker perception of the new phone's feature and design upgrades; the Japanese market was affected by exchange rates amplifying the price increase. 该机构认为，中国市场受益于上市初期供货改善，以及安卓竞品旗舰机型涨价。美国消费者对新机功能、设计升级的感知较弱；日本市场则受到汇率放大涨价幅度的影响。

The iPhone 18 Pro Max accounted for 56% of this generation's Pro series sales, slightly lower than the previous generation's 57%. Hsiu-Ching Lin, Associate Director at Counterpoint, stated that whether the strong performance in the Chinese market is due to concentrated early purchases still needs to be observed in the coming weeks; whether the iPhone Duo will generate new demand or divert sales from the Pro Max is also a short-term variable. iPhone 18 Pro Max 占本代 Pro 系列销量的 56%，略低于上一代的 57%。Counterpoint 副总监林秀晶表示，中国市场的强势是否来自提前集中购机，还需后续数周观察；iPhone Duo 能带来新增需求，还是分流 Pro Max，也是短期变量。

item.title: 有线电视与 IPTV 新规：不得播放开机广告，首页须设免费专区
item.guid: 有线电视与-IPTV-新规：不得播放开机广告，首页须设免费专区
item.description:
The National Radio and Television Administration announced on October 27 the "Regulations on the Administration of Cable Radio and Television Operation Services" and the "Interim Regulations on the Administration of Interactive Network Television Operation Services". Both regulations will come into effect on November 27. 国家广播电视总局 10 月 27 日公布《有线广播电视运营服务管理规定》和《交互式网络电视运营服务管理暂行规定》，两份规章均将于 11 月 27 日施行。

The new regulations require relevant operation service providers to prioritize live broadcasting, enable full-screen live broadcasting upon startup, set up channel review entry points, and prohibit playing startup advertisements. Users should be able to conveniently choose to enter live broadcasting or the TV interactive homepage upon startup; smart TVs must also support prioritizing live channels. 新规要求相关运营服务提供者坚持直播优先，实现开机看全屏直播、设置频道回看入口，不得播放开机广告。用户应能通过便捷入口，自行选择开机进入直播或电视交互主页；智能电视机也须支持优先呈现直播频道。

In terms of fees and operation, the homepages of cable TV and IPTV must set up a free zone, primarily recommending high-quality free content, streamlining paid columns, and clearly indicating pricing information; the remote control should be able to switch live sources with one key, and terminals must continuously shorten startup times. 在收费和操作方面，有线电视与 IPTV 首页须设立免费专区，重点推荐优质免费内容，精简收费栏目并明示收费信息；遥控器应能一键切换直播信源，终端还须持续缩短开机时长。

item.title: IDC：中国手机 Q3 出货下滑 15.2%，折叠屏连续四季度下降
item.guid: IDC：中国手机-Q3-出货下滑-15.2%，折叠屏连续四季度下降
item.description:
IDC's quarterly tracking report released on October 27 shows that China's smartphone market shipments in the third quarter of this year were approximately 58.06 million units, a year-on-year decrease of 15.2%, further expanding from the approximately 4% decline in the first half of the year. IDC 10 月 27 日发布的季度跟踪报告显示，今年第三季度中国智能手机市场出货量约 5806 万台，同比下降 15.2%，降幅较上半年约 4% 进一步扩大。

IDC summarized the market as "declining volume, rising prices": the rising costs of storage and other components are passed on to terminals, manufacturers adjust configurations and raise prices, while consumers extend their replacement cycles. Huawei's market share rose to 21.1%, with shipments maintaining double-digit year-on-year growth; Honor is the only leading mainstream manufacturer to achieve positive month-on-month shipment growth. IDC 将市场概括为「量跌价升」：存储及其他元器件成本上涨传导至终端，厂商调整配置、提高定价，消费者则延长换机周期。华为市场份额升至 21.1%，出货量保持同比两位数增长；荣耀是头部主流厂商中唯一实现出货量环比正增长的品牌。

The adjustment for foldable phones is more pronounced, with approximately 1.77 million units shipped in the Chinese market in the third quarter, a year-on-year decrease of 32.7%, marking four consecutive quarters of decline. Huawei's share in this market exceeds 70%, followed by Samsung and Xiaomi. IDC expects that with Apple's entry and more brands launching new wide-foldable products, the domestic foldable phone market will rebound starting next quarter. 折叠屏的调整更明显，第三季度中国市场出货约 177 万台，同比下降 32.7%，已连续四个季度下滑。华为在该市场的份额超过 70%，三星与小米分列其后。IDC 预计，随着苹果入局、更多品牌推出阔折叠新品，国内折叠屏市场将从下一季度起回暖。

item.title: 张一鸣以 6700 亿元登顶胡润百富榜，梁文锋首次上榜排第七
item.guid: 张一鸣以-6700-亿元登顶胡润百富榜，梁文锋首次上榜排第七
item.description:
The Hurun Research Institute released the "2026 Hurun Rich List" on October 27. ByteDance founder Zhang Yiming became China's richest person for the second time with a fortune of 670 billion yuan, an increase of 200 billion yuan from last year, setting a new record for the richest person in China on the list. 胡润研究院 10 月 27 日发布《2026 胡润百富榜》，字节跳动创始人张一鸣以 6700 亿元财富第二次成为中国首富，较去年增加 2000 亿元，并刷新榜单的中国首富财富纪录。

Nongfu Spring founder Zhong Shanshan dropped to second place with 410 billion yuan. DeepSeek founder Liang Wenfeng debuted on the list, ranking seventh with 280 billion yuan; Unitree Robotics founder Wang Xingxing also debuted, with a fortune of 69.5 billion yuan. 农夫山泉创始人钟睒睒以 4100 亿元退居第二。DeepSeek 创始人梁文锋首次上榜，以 2800 亿元位列第七；宇树科技创始人王兴兴也首次上榜，财富为 695 亿元。

This year's list includes 1,529 entrepreneurs with personal wealth exceeding 5 billion yuan, an increase of 95 from last year, with a total wealth of 32 trillion yuan. Hurun stated that industries such as semiconductors, artificial intelligence, and robotics were prominent areas of wealth growth this year. The wealth calculation for the list was截止 on September 1, estimated using public equity, market value, and survey information. 本次榜单共有 1529 位个人财富 50 亿元以上的企业家，比去年增加 95 位，总财富为 32 万亿元。胡润称，半导体、人工智能、机器人等行业是今年财富增长较突出的领域。榜单的财富计算截止日为 9 月 1 日，采用公开股权、市场价值及调研信息进行估算。

item.title: 邓煜：AI 公司应公开证明思路，让用户决定数据是否用于训练
item.guid: 邓煜：AI-公司应公开证明思路，让用户决定数据是否用于训练
item.description:
Mathematician Deng Yu spoke at a forum jointly organized by "The Intellectual" and "Science & Culture" on October 25, stating that AI has greatly promoted mathematical research, but companies providing models also need to address issues of academic norms, sources of ideas, and user rights. 数学家邓煜在 10 月 25 日由《知识分子》《赛先生》联合举办的论坛演讲中谈到，AI 对数学研究有很大促进作用，但提供模型的公司同样需要面对学术规范、思想来源和用户权益问题。

He believes that if AI is treated as a researcher publishing research results, it should explain how major proofs were obtained and clarify whose ideas were adopted. Mathematicians need to answer these questions when reporting results, and AI companies should also disclose corresponding thought chains, not just refuse on the grounds of preventing distillation. 他认为，如果把 AI 当作发表研究成果的研究者，就应解释重大证明是如何得到的，说明其中沿用了哪些人的思路。数学家报告成果时需要回答这些问题，AI 公司也应公开相应思维链，不能仅以防止蒸馏为由拒绝。

From a commercial perspective, Deng Yu questioned: if mathematicians pay to use tools and input research ideas, and then the model provider uses these ideas to train products and publish results, how should the user's contribution be acknowledged? He advocates that users should have the choice of whether to allow input data to participate in training. 从商业关系看，邓煜质疑：数学家付费使用工具、输入研究思路后，模型提供方再利用这些思路训练产品并发布成果，用户的贡献应如何得到承认？他主张，是否允许输入数据参与训练，应由用户自行选择。

He also emphasized that mathematicians should not refuse to use AI, but rather use it as a tool to advance research, with humans posing questions and guiding direction. His proposed solutions include establishing a traceability mechanism for ideas and contributions, allowing results to indicate who initially proposed a certain idea. 他同时强调，数学家不应拒绝使用 AI，而应把它作为推进研究的工具，由人提出问题、把握方向。他提出的方案包括建立思路和贡献的追溯机制，让成果能够说明某个想法最初由谁提出。

item.title: 研究：豆包引用抖音的权重升至 31.8%
item.guid: 研究：豆包引用抖音的权重升至-31.8%
item.description:
NewRank Service's AI source research shows that among its monitored samples, Doubao's citation weight for Douyin content increased from 10.79% in May this year to 31.8% in August, nearly one-third. 新榜服务发布的 AI 信源研究显示，在其监测样本中，豆包对抖音内容的引用权重由今年 5 月的 10.79% 升至 8 月的 31.8%，接近三分之一。

The report also stated that Baidu first included Bilibili and Haokan Video in its monitored citation sources in June, with their combined weight reaching 12%; by August, Bilibili's weight stabilized at 8.4%, ranking second. 报告还称，百度在 6 月首次将 B 站和好看视频纳入所监测的引用信源，两者权重合计达到 12%；到 8 月，B 站权重稳定在 8.4%，排在第二位。

NewRank further analyzed the relationship between video titles and citation frequency, finding that the semantic relevance of titles to questions, and whether they contain brands and professional terms, are more explanatory than simply increasing title length or stacking specifications. These results are derived from NewRank Zhihui's monitoring and statistics, reflecting the citation distribution in the covered questions and content samples. 新榜进一步分析视频标题与引用次数的关系，发现标题与问题的语义相关性、是否包含品牌和专业术语，比单纯增加标题长度或堆砌规格数字更有解释力。这些结果来自新榜智汇的监测与统计，反映所覆盖问题和内容样本中的引用分布。

item.title: 大众在海外召回约 7.27 万辆电动车，部分车型充电上限暂降至 80%
item.guid: 大众在海外召回约-7.27-万辆电动车，部分车型充电上限暂降至-80%
item.description:
According to Yicai, three batches of recall filings announced by the German Federal Motor Transport Authority collectively involve approximately 72,700 Volkswagen Group electric vehicles, including some Volkswagen ID.3, ID.4, ID.7, ID.Buzz, and Cupra Born, due to safety risks with high-voltage battery cells. 据第一财经报道，德国联邦汽车运输管理局公布的三批召回备案，合计涉及约 7.27 万辆大众集团电动车，包括部分大众 ID.3、ID.4、ID.7、ID.Buzz 和 Cupra Born，原因是高压电池电芯存在安全隐患。

Volkswagen UK's official website confirmed that some ID.3, ID.4, and ID.7 vehicles using high-voltage batteries produced by a specific supplier between 2022 and 2025 need inspection; when the battery charge exceeds 80%, the battery may overheat and pose a fire risk. The manufacturer has remotely set a temporary 80% charging limit for most affected vehicles and will subsequently notify owners for inspection and, if necessary, battery module replacement. 大众英国官网确认，使用特定供应商于 2022 至 2025 年生产的高压电池的部分 ID.3、ID.4、ID.7 需要检查；电量超过 80% 时，电池可能过热并有起火风险。厂商已通过远程方式为多数受影响车辆暂时设置 80% 充电上限，后续将通知车主检查，必要时更换电池模组。

Volkswagen UK did not disclose the supplier's name. Yicai pointed out that another recall document involving 22,524 ID.4 vehicles in the United States listed the supplier as SK On, but it cannot be concluded that all affected batteries in all regions are from this company. At the time of the report's publication, no recall announcement for the ID. series had been made in the Chinese market. 大众英国未披露供应商名称。第一财经指出，美国另一起涉及 22524 辆 ID.4 的召回文件将供应商列为 SK On，但不能据此认定所有地区涉事电池均来自该企业。报道发布时，中国市场尚未公布此次 ID. 系列召回公告。

item.title: 《宝可梦大集结》海外版将于明年 3 月停服，保留资料馆
item.guid: 《宝可梦大集结》海外版将于明年-3-月停服，保留资料馆
item.description:
The official Japanese website for "Pokémon UNITE" announced on October 27 that the Nintendo Switch and mobile versions will cease service on March 23 next year at 9 AM Japan time, which is 8 AM Beijing time. On the same day, the official service stopped selling gems and accepting new subscriptions and automatic renewals for UNITE membership; existing gems and membership benefits can continue to be used within their respective validity periods. 《Pokémon UNITE》日本官网 10 月 27 日公告，Nintendo Switch 版和手机版将于明年 3 月 23 日日本时间 9 时、即北京时间 8 时结束服务。官方当日已停止宝石销售，以及 UNITE 会员的新订阅和自动续费；现有宝石与会员权益可在相应期限内继续使用。

The official plan is to add a "Data Archive" feature on November 12, allowing players to view acquired electronic outfits, fashion items, achievements, and some match records even after the service ends. Players need to download relevant data before the service concludes; missing data cannot be downloaded after the service stops. 官方计划于 11 月 12 日加入「资料馆」功能，让玩家在停服后仍能查看已获得的电子服、时装、成就和部分比赛记录。玩家需要在服务结束前下载相关资料，停服后将无法再下载缺失数据。

The previously announced Pokémon UNITE Aeos Crown 2027 Tokyo tournament will still be held as planned. Unused paid gems will be eligible for refund applications after the service ends, with the specific process to be announced separately by the official channels. This announcement is for the overseas version. 此前公布的 Pokémon UNITE Aeos Crown 2027 Tokyo 赛事仍将按计划举办。未使用的付费宝石将在停服后开放退款申请，具体流程由官方另行说明。本次公告针对海外版。

item.title: 红果否认「年收入 400 亿元」传闻，称大部分收入用于内容投入
item.guid: 红果否认「年收入-400-亿元」传闻，称大部分收入用于内容投入
item.description:
Hongguo Short Drama issued a statement on October 27, denying online rumors such as "annualized revenue approaching 40 billion yuan" and "this year's revenue reaching 42 billion to 45 billion yuan," stating that the relevant revenue data is untrue. 红果短剧 10 月 27 日发布声明，否认网络流传的「年化收入逼近 400 亿元」「今年营收达 420 亿元至 450 亿元」等说法，称相关收入数据不实。

The statement pointed out that the "institutional data," "industry data," and "expert estimates" cited in the online content are not official information, and the comparisons, extrapolations, and extended interpretations made from them also lack factual basis. 声明指出，网传内容援引的「机构数据」「行业数据」「专家预计」均非官方信息，由此作出的比较、推算和延伸解读也没有事实依据。

Hongguo also stated that most of the platform's current revenue continues to be used for content creator revenue sharing, copyright guarantees, and support for high-quality content. 红果同时表示，目前平台大部分收入持续用于内容创作者分账、版权保底和优质内容扶持。

item.title: 小米武汉首个员工住宅开盘，297 套房限内部员工购买
item.guid: 小米武汉首个员工住宅开盘，297-套房限内部员工购买
item.description:
According to a report by "21st Century Business Herald," Xiaomi's first employee housing project in Wuhan, "Optics Valley Dream Home," has opened for sale. The project plans for 4 residential buildings with a total of 297 units, with a registered average price of 13,885 yuan per square meter. The purchasing eligibility is limited to current official employees within the Xiaomi system who have signed labor contracts and regularly pay social insurance. 据《21 世纪经济报道》报道，小米在武汉的首个员工住宅项目「光谷梦享家」已开盘，项目规划 4 栋住宅、共 297 套房源，备案均价为每平方米 13885 元，购房对象限定为小米体系内已签订劳动合同、正常缴纳社保的在职正式员工。

The project is about 700 meters from Xiaomi Wuhan Technology Park, offering three-bedroom units of approximately 110 square meters and 122-125 square meters, as well as four-bedroom units of approximately 143 square meters, delivered as unfinished shells. The report cited Chen Bo, general manager of Xiaomi's ecosystem chain, stating that it takes about 10 minutes to walk from the project to the technology park. 项目距离小米武汉科技园约 700 米，提供约 110 平方米、122—125 平方米的三房，以及约 143 平方米的四房，按毛坯标准交付。报道援引小米生态链总经理陈波的介绍称，从项目步行到科技园需 10 分钟左右。

According to the pre-sale information disclosed by the Wuhan Housing and Urban Renewal Bureau, the project obtained its pre-sale permit on October 16. The developer is Mi Space Wuhan Information Technology Co., Ltd., a wholly-owned subsidiary of Xiaomi, and delivery is planned for May 2028. 武汉市住房和城市更新局公示的预售资料显示，项目于 10 月 16 日取得预售许可，开发主体为小米全资子公司谧空间武汉信息科技有限公司，计划于 2028 年 5 月交付。

item.title: AMD 将向 Meta 投资 10 亿美元，Helios 机架已安装测试
item.guid: AMD-将向-Meta-投资-10-亿美元，Helios-机架已安装测试
item.description:
AMD announced its participation in Meta's equity offering with a $1 billion investment. Both parties also disclosed progress in their computing power collaboration: the first batch of Helios rack-scale systems has been installed and is undergoing testing at Meta, with plans for expanded deployment later. AMD 宣布将参与 Meta 的股权发行，投资 10 亿美元。双方同时披露算力合作进展：首批 Helios 机架级系统已在 Meta 安装并进行测试，后续计划扩大部署。

AMD's EPYC processors provide a dedicated computing environment for Meta's Muse personal AI agents. Meta has deployed millions of EPYC processors across different generations and is among the first key customers for the sixth-generation EPYC; both parties are also collaborating on developing subsequent platforms. AMD 的 EPYC 处理器为 Meta 的 Muse 个人 AI 智能体提供专用计算环境。Meta 已部署数百万颗不同代际的 EPYC，并成为第六代 EPYC 的首批重要客户；双方还在合作开发后续平台。

On the GPU side, Meta has used Instinct for training, ranking, and recommendation systems, and plans to deploy custom GPUs optimized for its own workloads. Software collaboration covers PyTorch, Triton, and ROCm; Muse Spark Open has received day-one support for Instinct, while Muse Glimmer supports Ryzen AI PCs and Radeon GPUs. 在 GPU 端，Meta 已将 Instinct 用于训练、排序与推荐系统，并计划部署针对自身工作负载优化的定制 GPU。软件合作覆盖 PyTorch、Triton 和 ROCm；Muse Spark Open 已获得 Instinct 首日支持，Muse Glimmer 则支持 Ryzen AI PC 与 Radeon GPU。

item.title: Meta AI 总监离职创办 Ndoc，想把文档、数据与演示放进同一工作区
item.guid: Meta-AI-总监离职创办-Ndoc，想把文档、数据与演示放进同一工作区
item.description:
According to TechCrunch's interview with Rohit Patel, the former director of Meta's Superintelligence Lab, who worked at Meta for about 8 years, has left to found Ndoc, an AI-native office software, hoping to integrate scattered work between tools like Excel, Word, and PowerPoint into a single interface. 据 TechCrunch 对罗希特·帕特尔（Rohit Patel）的采访，这位在 Meta 工作约 8 年的超级智能实验室前总监已离职，创办 AI 原生办公软件 Ndoc，希望把 Excel、Word、PowerPoint 等工具间分散的工作整合到同一界面。

Ndoc divides the workspace into three parts: Stage for displaying slides, dashboards, and mini-applications; Narrative for analysis, numbered references, and charts; and Model for storing underlying datasets and Python scripts. After users upload data, they can have AI analyze and generate explanations, check calculation scripts, or ask AI to explain the code where formulas are located. Ndoc 将工作区分为三部分：Stage 展示幻灯片、仪表盘和迷你应用；Narrative 放分析、编号引用和图表；Model 保存底层数据集与 Python 脚本。用户上传数据后，可让 AI 分析并生成说明，也能检查计算脚本，或请 AI 解释公式所在的代码。

Patel stated that documents can be exported as a single ".ndoc.html" file that browsers can open, and he plans to open up this format. The team currently has 3 members, has not yet raised funding, is conducting enterprise pilots, and is opening an alpha version to a small number of clients on a waiting list; registration is free, while usage and token consumption are charged. A beta version is planned for release in the coming weeks, with the full product scheduled for next year. 帕特尔称，文档可导出为浏览器能打开的单个「.ndoc.html」文件，他计划开放这一格式。团队目前有 3 人、尚未融资，正在开展企业试点，并向候补名单中的少量客户开放 alpha 版；注册免费，使用与 Token 消耗收费。beta 版计划在未来数周推出，完整产品计划明年发布。

item.title: 金山办公 Q3 归母净利降 72.3%，经调整净利增 8.44%
item.guid: 金山办公-Q3-归母净利降-72.3%，经调整净利增-8.44%
item.description:
Kingsoft Office disclosed its third-quarter report on October 27. In the third quarter, operating revenue was 1.766 billion yuan, a year-on-year increase of 16.11%; net profit attributable to the parent company was 119 million yuan, a year-on-year decrease of 72.3%, mainly due to reduced investment income from external investment fund projects. Non-recurring net profit was 114 million yuan, a year-on-year decrease of 72.85%. 金山办公 10 月 27 日披露三季报，第三季度营业收入为 17.66 亿元，同比增长 16.11%；归母净利润为 1.19 亿元，同比下降 72.3%，主要受对外投资基金项目投资收益降低影响。扣非净利润为 1.14 亿元，同比下降 72.85%。

The company disclosed an adjusted net profit attributable to the parent company of 539 million yuan, a year-on-year increase of 8.44%. This metric excludes share-based payment expenses, fund-related investment income, and the income tax impact corresponding to these adjustments. 公司披露的经调整归母净利润为 5.39 亿元，同比增长 8.44%。这一口径剔除了股份支付费用、基金相关投资收益，以及这些调整事项对应的所得税影响。

By business segment: 分业务来看：

  • WPS personal business revenue was 1.050 billion yuan, a year-on-year increase of 16.78%. The company stated that new AI products like "Lingxi" have driven an increase in paid conversion rates and average customer spending. WPS 个人业务收入 10.50 亿元，同比增长 16.78%。公司称，全新版「灵犀」等 AI 产品带动了付费转化率及客单价提升。
  • WPS 365 business revenue was 270 million yuan, a year-on-year increase of 33.83%. The enterprise-grade product WPS Comate can connect to enterprise data and business systems, execute tasks, and manage data and permission boundaries. WPS 365 业务收入 2.70 亿元，同比增长 33.83%，企业级产品 WPS Comate 可连接企业数据与业务系统、执行任务，并管控数据和权限边界。
  • WPS software business revenue was 414 million yuan, a year-on-year increase of 5.78%. WPS 软件业务收入 4.14 亿元，同比增长 5.78%。

The net cash flow from operating activities in the third quarter was 467 million yuan, a year-on-year decrease of 13.23%. As of the end of September, WPS Office's global monthly active devices reached 678 million, with 341 million for PC and 337 million for mobile. 第三季度经营活动现金流量净额为 4.67 亿元，同比下降 13.23%。截至 9 月底，WPS Office 全球月度活跃设备数为 6.78 亿，其中 PC 版为 3.41 亿，移动版为 3.37 亿。

item.title: 💡 微软 CEO 纳德拉：AI 更强，并不会自动变得更安全
item.guid: 💡-微软-CEO-纳德拉：AI-更强，并不会自动变得更安全
item.description:
Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella said on the 20VC podcast that he has changed a judgment he once believed: that alignment between AI and human goals would naturally emerge as model capabilities improved. Here, 'alignment' refers to making AI's behavior consistent with human values and goals. 微软 CEO 萨提亚·纳德拉在 20VC 播客中说，他改变了一个过去相信的判断：模型能力提升后，AI 与人类目标的对齐会自然出现。这里的「对齐」，指让 AI 的行为符合人类的价值与目标。

According to Business Insider's report on the interview, host Harry Stebbings asked him what views he had changed over the past year. Nadella replied that model scaling and capability advancements largely met his expectations, but alignment remains a separate challenge. 据《商业内幕》对访谈的报道，主持人 Harry Stebbings 问他，过去一年改变了什么看法。纳德拉回答，模型扩展和能力进步大体符合他的预期，但对齐仍是一项独立的挑战。

I used to think that alignment would naturally occur. I no longer believe that. I think alignment might be a more difficult and different problem.

Nadella previously suggested on October 10 that enterprises should treat AI models as potential internal threats and assume that models might have been compromised. For enterprise deployment, his proposed solution is to establish deterministic system designs, human control, and reliable operational processes outside of non-deterministic models; new standards also need to be developed when existing industry standards are insufficient. 纳德拉此前于 10 月 10 日提出，企业应把 AI 模型当作潜在的内部威胁，并假设模型可能已被攻陷。对企业部署而言，他给出的办法是在非确定性模型外建立确定性的系统设计、人类控制和可靠的操作流程；现有行业标准不足时，还需要制定新标准。

item.title: 2999 元起，REDMI K100 发布：10000mAh 电池配双芯
item.guid: 2999-元起，REDMI-K100-发布：10000mAh-电池配双芯
item.description:
The REDMI K100 was released and pre-sales began on October 27. The standard version is equipped with the D2 dedicated gaming display chip for the first time, paired with the Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Ultimate Edition, focusing on gaming performance and long battery life. REDMI K100 于 10 月 27 日发布并开启预售，标准版首次搭载游戏独显 D2，配合高通骁龙 8 至尊版，主打游戏性能和大电池续航。

The phone features a 6.83-inch flat screen, supporting a 165Hz refresh rate, full-brightness DC dimming, and 3500nits peak brightness. The official statement claims the screen natively supports over 40 high-frame-rate games, and the dedicated display chip can be used for super-resolution and super-frame processing. 手机配备 6.83 英寸直屏，支持 165Hz 刷新率、全亮度 DC 调光及 3500nits 峰值亮度。官方称，屏幕已原生适配超过 40 款高帧率游戏，独显芯片可用于超分辨率与超帧处理。

Regarding battery life, the K100 has a built-in 10000mAh battery, supporting 100W wired fast charging and 27W wired reverse charging. Xiaomi Lab's DOU battery life test result is 2.43 days. Other configurations include a 50-megapixel main camera, 3D ultrasonic fingerprint sensor, and the pre-installed Xiaomi HyperOS 4. 续航方面，K100 内置 10000mAh 电池，支持 100W 有线快充及 27W 有线反充。小米实验室给出的 DOU 续航测试结果为 2.43 天。其他配置包括 5000 万像素主摄、3D 超声波指纹，以及出厂搭载的小米澎湃 OS 4。

The Double 11 limited-time special prices for the 12GB + 256GB, 12GB + 512GB, and 16GB + 512GB versions are 2999 yuan, 3499 yuan, and 3899 yuan respectively; the initial price after national subsidy is 2549.15 yuan. The new phone will officially go on sale at 10:00 on October 31, available in black, snow rock white, and flowing green. 12GB + 256GB、12GB + 512GB、16GB + 512GB 三个版本的双 11 限时特惠价分别为 2999 元、3499 元和 3899 元；首档叠加国补后的价格为 2549.15 元。新机将于 10 月 31 日 10 时正式开售，提供黑色、雪岩白和流萤绿三种配色。

item.title: REDMI Book 2027 换新模具，14 英寸轻至 1.28kg
item.guid: REDMI-Book-2027-换新模具，14-英寸轻至-1.28kg
item.description:
REDMI launched the Book 2027 series at its October 27 press conference, marking the first mold update for this digital series in three years. The new products come in 14-inch and 16-inch sizes, offering four color options: Moonlight Silver, Space Gray, Nebula Purple, and Sea Breeze Blue; the 14-inch model weighs as little as 1.28kg, with the thickest part of the body being 13.95mm. REDMI 在 10 月 27 日的发布会上推出 Book 2027 系列，这是该数字系列时隔三年的模具更新。新品有 14 英寸和 16 英寸两种尺寸，提供月光银、深空灰、星云紫和海风蓝四种配色；14 英寸机型轻至 1.28kg，机身最厚处为 13.95mm。

The series is equipped with a 3rd Gen Intel Core processor, LPDDR5X 7467MT/s memory, and features dual-fan cooling, with official claims of stable performance release up to 30W for the entire machine. It has a built-in 72Wh battery, with an official simulated office battery life of 20.2 hours, and comes standard with a 68W USB-C power adapter. 系列搭载第三代英特尔酷睿处理器、LPDDR5X 7467MT/s 内存，采用双风扇散热，官方称整机稳定性能释放最高 30W。内置 72Wh 电池，官方模拟办公续航为 20.2 小时，标配 68W USB-C 电源适配器。

The software comes pre-installed with Super Xiao Ai 2.0, which can call upon the Xiaomi MiMo model to complete tasks such as PPT presentations and web data dashboards; the PC version of Xiaomi Notes supports synchronization with phones and tablets, as well as Mi Home remote power on/off and tablet remote control. Pre-orders for the new products have begun, with sales starting on November 3. The 14-inch Core i5 320, 16GB + 512GB version has a final price of 5779.15 yuan after national subsidies in applicable regions. 软件预装超级小爱 2.0，可调用小米 MiMo 模型完成 PPT、网页数据看板等任务；小米笔记 PC 版支持与手机、平板同步，也支持米家远程开关机和平板远程控制。新品已开启预约，11 月 3 日发售，14 英寸酷睿 5 320、16GB + 512GB 版本在适用地区的国补到手价为 5779.15 元。

item.title: Rokid 新眼镜接入微信，手势戒指可盲操回复与翻页

item.description:
At the Rokid Jungle 2026 launch event on October 27, Rokid showcased its new generation of AI glasses and accompanying interactions: Rokid Glasses 2, the binocular full-color glasses Rokid Color, and the smart ring 'Rokid Magic Ring'. 在 10 月 27 日的 Rokid Jungle 2026 发布会上，乐奇展示了新一代 AI 眼镜与配套交互：Rokid Glasses 2、双目全彩眼镜 Rokid Color，以及智能戒指「乐奇魔戒」。

Rokid has integrated WeChat into its glasses. Upon receiving messages, notifications can be displayed in the lens's field of view, and users can confirm and reply to messages via voice or with fingertip gestures using the ring. 乐奇已将微信接入眼镜端。收到消息后，通知可显示在镜片视野中，用户可通过语音，或搭配戒指的指尖手势确认并回复消息。

It can be used for teleprompter page turning, switching songs, capturing photos, and confirming AI commands, reducing the need to touch the temple of the glasses or speak aloud in public. 「乐奇魔戒」支持轻触、双击、滑动和长按等操作，可用于提词器翻页、切歌、抓拍以及确认 AI 指令，减少触摸镜腿或在公共场所开口操作的需要。

item.title: Google 发布世界模型 Genie 4：支持原生音频，模拟时长延长至两分钟
item.guid: Google-发布世界模型-Genie-4：支持原生音频，模拟时长延长至两分钟
item.description:
Google DeepMind yesterday released its new generation world model, Genie 4, which supports real-time generation of visuals, native audio, and physical simulations. The duration of a single interactive simulation is approximately two minutes, an increase from about one minute in the previous generation. Google DeepMind 昨日发布新一代世界模型 Genie 4，支持实时生成画面、原生音频和物理模拟，单次交互模拟时长约为两分钟，较上一代的约一分钟有所延长。

Users can generate an explorable virtual world by entering a piece of text, and control character movement and adjust the camera with the keyboard. During operation, users can also continue to input prompts to change the weather, add characters, or objects. 用户输入一段文字即可生成可探索的虚拟世界，并通过键盘控制角色移动、调整镜头。在运行过程中，用户还能继续输入提示词，改变天气、添加人物或物体。

Genie 4 supports native audio generation for the first time, capable of real-time generation of environmental sounds, music, and character dialogue. Virtual characters can dynamically generate language and reactions based on user input and scene changes. Genie 4 首次支持原生音频生成，可实时生成环境声音、音乐和人物对话，虚拟角色能根据用户输入和场景变化动态生成语言与反应。

In terms of physical simulation, Google demonstrated cases such as watermelons being impacted, maple seeds falling, and a crowded rural train station, involving collision, aerodynamics, gravity, and complex crowd behavior. 物理模拟方面，谷歌展示了西瓜受冲击、枫树种子飘落、拥挤的乡村火车站等案例，涉及碰撞、空气动力学、重力和复杂人群行为。

item.title: 微信输入法新增「AI 录音笔」，录音可实时整理成结构化网页
item.guid: 微信输入法新增「AI-录音笔」，录音可实时整理成结构化网页
item.description:
WeChat Pai introduced that WeChat Input Method has added the "AI Recording Pen" capability, which can transcribe recordings into structured web pages in real-time and organize key points and logic based on context. 微信派介绍，微信输入法新增「AI 录音笔」能力，可将录音实时转写为结构化网页，并按上下文整理重点和逻辑。

In addition to converting to text, the feature can also correct typos, remove redundant verbal expressions, and generate charts, diagrams, and interactive prototypes based on the content. WeChat Pai demonstrated organization scenarios such as meeting minutes, live content reviews, family affairs, and travel discussions. The summary page can be shared with friends via the "Share" button in the upper right corner. 功能除了转成文字，还能修正错别字、删去冗余口头表达，并根据内容生成图表、图示和交互原型。微信派展示了会议纪要、直播内容回顾、家庭事务和旅行讨论等整理场景，总结页面可通过右上角的「分享」按钮发给好友。

On mobile, it can be accessed from the keyboard toolbar or the WeChat Input Method App; on desktop, it can be opened via hotkeys, the Mac top menu bar, or the Windows toolbar. This feature supports multi-device synchronization, allowing associated devices to sync historical recording summaries. Users can experience it in the latest version of WeChat Input Method. 手机端可从键盘工具栏或微信输入法 App 进入；电脑端可通过快捷键、Mac 顶部菜单栏或 Windows 工具栏打开。该功能支持多端同步，关联设备之间可以同步历史录音总结，用户可在最新版微信输入法中体验。

item.title: 百度开源 Unlimited OCR 2，称可一次解析 3600 页《哈利·波特》
item.guid: 百度开源-Unlimited-OCR-2，称可一次解析-3600-页《哈利·波特》
item.description:
Baidu released and open-sourced Wenxin Unlimited OCR 2 on October 27, focusing on continuous parsing of ultra-long documents. Baidu stated that the model can process all 7 books of the "Harry Potter" series, totaling over 3600 pages, in a single task, maintaining relatively stable parsing accuracy and processing efficiency even as documents grow. 百度 10 月 27 日发布并开源文心 Unlimited OCR 2，主打超长文档的连续解析。百度称，模型可在一次任务中处理《哈利·波特》全系列 7 部作品、合计超过 3600 页，在文档增长后保持较稳定的解析精度与处理效率。

Its core is the Sparse Reference Sliding Window Attention (SR-SWA) mechanism: first, page gating narrows down the scope of relevant pages, then key visual tokens are selected, reducing redundant calculations for the entire document. Coupled with an infinite decoding mechanism, the model controls the computational and memory overhead required for single-step decoding within a relatively stable range. 其核心是稀疏参考滑动窗口注意力机制 SR-SWA：先由页面门控缩小相关页面范围，再选取关键视觉 Token，减少对整份文档重复计算。配合无限解码机制，模型将单步解码所需的计算和显存开销控制在较稳定的范围内。

Baidu announced that the comprehensive scores for MPDocBench and MarathonDocBench are 84.6 and 77.1, respectively. The code and model weights are now available on GitHub and Hugging Face, allowing developers to use Transformers or SGLang for inference; Baidu AI Cloud and AI Open Platform have also launched related capabilities. 百度公布的 MPDocBench 和 MarathonDocBench 综合得分分别为 84.6 和 77.1。代码和模型权重已在 GitHub、Hugging Face 开放，开发者可使用 Transformers 或 SGLang 推理；百度智能云和 AI 开放平台也已上线相关能力。

item.title: 灵光 2.0 全面开放，可持续盯价、记住前情并跟进事务
item.guid: 灵光-2.0-全面开放，可持续盯价、记住前情并跟进事务
item.description:
Ant Group launched Lingguang 2.0, positioning it as an "AI assistant that can manage affairs," expanding from single-round conversations to continuously tracking personal agents. After users close the app, tasks can still run on an independent cloud host and its browser, reminding users when there are results or decisions needed. 蚂蚁推出灵光 2.0，将其定位为「能管事的 AI 助理」，从单轮对话扩展到持续跟进的个人 Agent。用户关掉 App 后，任务仍可在独立云主机及其浏览器中运行，并在有结果或需要决策时提醒用户。

In APPSO's experience, Lingguang can read pet insurance contracts, organize reimbursement conditions, and set follow-up reminders, as well as remember previous communications; when shopping, it can compare prices of the same product on different platforms, calculate discounts, and continuously track price changes. After changes in travel numbers or weather, it can also adjust routes and arrangements based on existing preferences. APPSO 的体验中，灵光可读取宠物保险合同、整理报销条件并设置后续提醒，也能记住此前沟通的情况；购物时可比较同款商品在不同平台的价格、折算优惠，并持续跟踪价格变化。旅行人数或天气变化后，它还能基于已有偏好调整路线和安排。

Lingguang 2.0 supports users authorizing access to services like Alipay bills, organizing periodic deductions and consumption records, and can also connect to tools like DingTalk and Feishu. In these experience scenarios, information organization, reminders, and follow-ups are handled by AI, while the final decision remains with the user. 灵光 2.0 支持用户授权接入支付宝账单等服务，整理周期性扣款和消费记录，也可连接钉钉、飞书等工具。在这些体验场景中，信息整理、提醒和后续跟进由 AI 承担，最终决定仍交给用户。

item.title: 英伟达 RTX 路径追踪工具更新，新增 Windows on Arm 支持
item.guid: 英伟达-RTX-路径追踪工具更新，新增-Windows-on-Arm-支持
item.description:
NVIDIA's RTX Path Tracing tool has been updated to 1.9.0. Official release notes indicate that the new version offers approximately 20% overall performance improvement compared to 1.8.1 under equivalent or better image quality conditions, and adds Windows on ARM64 support. 英伟达 RTX Path Tracing 工具已更新至 1.9.0。官方发布记录显示，新版相较 1.8.1 在画质相当或更好的条件下，整体性能约提升 20%，并新增 Windows on ARM64 支持。

This optimization includes overlapping the execution of some path tracing tasks with DLSS Ray Reconstruction and post-processing in an asynchronous compute queue, reducing CPU frame time in scenes with many instances, and decreasing memory footprint for acceleration structures. 本次优化包括将部分路径追踪任务与 DLSS 光线重建、后处理放在异步计算队列中重叠执行，在实例较多的场景降低 CPU 帧耗时，并减少加速结构的内存占用。

The new version also defaults to enabling SHaRC radiance cache, providing more indirect illumination at a similar cost; the number of light sources NEE-AT can handle has increased from 512,000 to 2 million. This tool provides developers with real-time path tracing examples and reference implementations. The official release notes for 1.9.0 were published on October 23. 新版还默认启用 SHaRC 辐射缓存，以相近成本提供更多间接光照；NEE-AT 可处理的光源数量由 51.2 万提升至 200 万。该工具面向开发者提供实时路径追踪的示例和参考实现，1.9.0 的官方版本记录发布于 10 月 23 日。

item.title: 富士 mini Evo 2 加入触屏与短片，11 月 27 日起发售
item.guid: 富士-mini-Evo-2-加入触屏与短片，11-月-27-日起发售
item.description:
Fujifilm released the hybrid instant camera instax mini Evo 2, retaining the method of selecting and printing photos after digital capture. It is the first instax series camera to feature a touchscreen, with a 4.5-inch screen for adjusting settings and browsing photos. 富士发布混合型拍立得相机 instax mini Evo 2，保留数码拍摄后挑选照片打印的方式，首次为 instax 系列加入触摸屏，4.5 英寸屏幕可用于调整设置及滑动浏览照片。

According to an announcement from Fujifilm Japan headquarters on October 27, the new camera's maximum photo resolution has been increased to 13 megapixels. To use this resolution, a microSD card must be inserted, and the "Expanded View" mode must be turned off. Expanded View displays the area outside the print frame on the screen, helping to determine when a moving subject enters the composition. 根据富士日本总部 10 月 27 日公告，新机最高照片分辨率提升至 1300 万像素，使用这一分辨率需插入 microSD 卡，并关闭「Expanded View」扩展取景模式。扩展取景可在屏幕中显示打印画框之外的区域，帮助判断移动主体何时进入构图。

A new "Immersive Movie" feature records the moments before the shutter is pressed, generating 5-second, 9:16 vertical short videos. These videos can be reviewed on the camera or transferred to a smartphone via a dedicated app; the camera still retains a combination of 10 lens effects and 10 film effects. 新增「Immersive Movie」功能用于记录按下快门前的拍摄瞬间，生成 5 秒、9:16 竖屏短片。短片可在相机上回看，也可通过专用 App 传输至手机；相机仍保留 10 种镜头效果和 10 种胶片效果的组合。

The mini Evo 2 will be available starting November 27. Fujifilm North America announced a suggested retail price of $289.95 in the US. mini Evo 2 将于 11 月 27 日起发售。富士北美公布的美国建议零售价为 289.95 美元。

item.title: 影石 Luna Ultra 获 Wirecutter 便携 Vlog 相机推荐
item.guid: 影石-Luna-Ultra-获-Wirecutter-便携-Vlog-相机推荐
item.description:
The New York Times' Wirecutter, in its updated "Best Vlog Cameras and Equipment" guide, listed Insta360 Luna Ultra as a recommended portable, carry-on camera and suggested creators seeking an integrated shooting solution choose its Creator Kit. 《纽约时报》旗下 Wirecutter 在更新的《最佳 Vlog 相机及设备》指南中，将影石 Luna Ultra 列为便携、可随身携带的相机推荐，并建议希望获得一体化拍摄方案的创作者选择其创作者套装。

This guide was updated on October 14. Wirecutter highlighted features such as in-body gimbal stabilization, subject tracking, and a detachable 2-inch OLED touchscreen. When detached, the screen can serve as a wireless monitor and remote control, facilitating high-angle shots or shooting from unique perspectives; the kit microphone also underwent vocal pickup tests in noisy environments. 这份指南于 10 月 14 日更新。Wirecutter 看重的组合包括口袋机身内的云台防抖、主体追踪，以及可拆卸的 2 英寸 OLED 触屏。屏幕取下后可充当无线监看与遥控器，方便高举相机或从特殊机位拍摄；套装麦克风则在嘈杂场景下接受了人声收音测试。

The guide mentioned that Luna Ultra supports up to 8K 30fps and 4K 120fps recording, and offers 10-bit I-Log. Its standalone battery life was tested at approximately 2 hours and 45 minutes, and can be extended by about 1 hour with the battery grip. 指南提到，Luna Ultra 支持最高 8K 30 帧及 4K 120 帧录制，并提供 10-bit I-Log。其单机续航实测约 2 小时 45 分钟，搭配电池手柄可再延长约 1 小时。

Wirecutter also pointed out that the main camera's perspective may not be suitable for large group photos, and the deeper the digital zoom, the more obvious the loss of image quality; photographers who need a wider field of view or more lens options can consider other camera types. Wirecutter 也指出，主摄视角未必适合大合影，数字变焦越深入，画质损失越明显；需要更宽视野或更多镜头选择的拍摄者，可考虑其他相机类型。

item.title: 魏牌二代蓝山首秀，改用方盒子造型并提供五座、六座版本
item.guid: 魏牌二代蓝山首秀，改用方盒子造型并提供五座、六座版本
item.description:
The Wey Lanshan second generation was unveiled on October 27th. The new car features a boxy design, offers five- and six-seat versions, and its powertrain has been changed to a 2.0T plug-in hybrid system. 魏牌二代蓝山于 10 月 27 日亮相，新车采用方盒子造型，提供五座和六座版本，动力改为 2.0T 插电式混合动力系统。

According to reports from "Auto Industry Focus," the new car features a waterfall grille, retro round headlights, and an external spare tire. The tailgate adopts a side-opening design, and the roof is equipped with lidar. The five-seater version has a length of 5140mm, while the six-seater version is extended to 5300mm. The width and height are 2050mm and 1960mm, respectively, and both versions have a wheelbase of 3010mm. 据《汽车行业关注》报道，新车使用直瀑式格栅、复古圆形大灯及外挂备胎，尾门采用侧开设计，车顶配有激光雷达。五座版车长为 5140mm，六座版加长至 5300mm，宽度、高度分别为 2050mm 和 1960mm，两种版本轴距均为 3010mm。

The report cites declaration information stating that the engine's maximum power is 182kW, and the front and rear motor powers are 110kW and 220kW, respectively. The two battery capacities are 53.6kWh and 64.7kWh, corresponding to declared pure electric ranges of 220 kilometers and 270 kilometers. 报道援引申报信息称，发动机最大功率为 182kW，前、后电机功率分别为 110kW 和 220kW。两种电池容量分别为 53.6kWh 和 64.7kWh，对应申报纯电续航 220 公里和 270 公里。

item.title: 《刺客信条：黑旗 记忆重置》迎来最后一次大型更新，加入五轮新游戏＋
item.guid: 《刺客信条：黑旗-记忆重置》迎来最后一次大型更新，加入五轮新游戏＋
item.description:
Ubisoft announced that the final major content update for "Assassin's Creed IV: Black Flag - Memory Reset" will be pushed on October 27th at 22:00 Beijing time, adding "New Game+", Nightmare difficulty, and new collectible content across all platforms. Experience optimization updates will continue to be provided in the following months. 育碧宣布，《刺客信条：黑旗 记忆重置》最后一次大型内容更新将于北京时间 10 月 27 日 22 时推送，面向全平台加入「新游戏＋」、噩梦难度及新收集内容，后续数月还会继续提供体验优化更新。

New Game+ allows players to inherit Edward's tools, upgrades, unlocked weapons, as well as Jackdaw upgrades, unlocked crew skills, and pets. Players will need to re-recruit crew, capture strongholds, and the map fog will also reset. Each replay round will add elite soldiers and high-level patrol ships, with a maximum of five New Game+ rounds available, along with exclusive currency for new outfits. 新游戏＋可继承爱德华的工具、升级、已解锁武器，以及寒鸦号升级、已解锁船员技能和宠物等内容。玩家需要重新招募船员、夺取要塞，地图迷雾也会重置。每轮重玩会增加精英士兵和高等级巡逻船，最多可开启五轮新游戏＋，并加入专属货币兑换新装扮。

Nightmare mode increases enemy damage, shortens parry timing, and disables the protection mechanism against single fatal attacks; enemies detect players faster during stealth, and underwater creature damage and oxygen consumption also increase. 噩梦模式会提高敌人伤害、缩短格挡时机，并关闭防止单次致命攻击的保护机制；潜行中敌人发现玩家更快，水下生物伤害和氧气消耗也会增加。

The update also restores some original execution animations and adds hidden community chests, new outfits, and pet appearances. 更新还恢复了原版部分处决动作，加入隐藏社区宝箱、新服装及宠物外观。

item.title: 蚂蚁百灵开源 Ling-3.1 增强版，支持 100 万 Token 上下文
item.guid: 蚂蚁百灵开源-Ling-3.1-增强版，支持-100-万-Token-上下文
item.description:
Ant Group's Bailing open-sourced the Ling-3.1-flash-1019 model weights, adopting an MIT license and supporting 1 million Token context. The model has a total of 560 billion parameters, with 25 billion parameters activated per Token, using a hybrid linear MoE architecture. 蚂蚁百灵开源 Ling-3.1-flash-1019 模型权重，采用 MIT 许可证，支持 100 万 Token 上下文。模型总参数为 5600 亿，每个 Token 激活 250 亿参数，采用混合线性 MoE 架构。

The official model card states that the new version enhances reasoning and agent task capabilities through further post-training. The Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3.2 score increased from 41 in the previous generation to 44, and the AutomationBench-AA score increased from 62% to 68%; these are the evaluation results listed in the model card. 官方模型卡称，新版通过进一步后训练加强推理与智能体任务能力，Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3.2 得分由前代的 41 提升至 44，AutomationBench-AA 得分由 62% 提升至 68%；这些是模型卡列出的评测结果。

The deployment documentation provides SGLang and vLLM paths, supporting thought switches, tool calling, and MTP speculative decoding. The officially recommended SGLang example uses 8 H200 cards and lists a configuration method for 4 GB300 cards, primarily for server-side deployment. 部署文档提供 SGLang 与 vLLM 路径，支持思考开关、工具调用及 MTP 推测解码。官方推荐的 SGLang 示例使用 8 张 H200，并列出 4 张 GB300 的配置方式，主要面向服务端部署。

item.title: Liquid AI 发布 LFM3，小模型覆盖文本、图像、语音与决策
item.guid: Liquid-AI-发布-LFM3，小模型覆盖文本、图像、语音与决策
item.description:
Liquid AI released the LFM3 series, with the first 6 models all around 2 billion parameters in scale, covering text, vision, audio, full-modality, and decision-making tasks. They share the LFM3-1.7B foundational backbone, and their weights are now available on Hugging Face. Liquid AI 发布 LFM3 系列，首批 6 款模型均处于约 20 亿参数规模，覆盖文本、视觉、音频、全模态及决策任务，共用 LFM3-1.7B 基础骨干，权重已在 Hugging Face 上线。

The text model LFM3-1.7B supports 256K Token context, occupies about 1GB of memory at 4-bit precision, can run locally on mobile phones and laptops, and can also be fine-tuned with a single GPU. The new architecture combines gated short convolutions, sliding window attention, and global attention, and was pre-trained using 22 trillion Tokens; the model is geared towards local agents, tool calling, and specific task customization. 文本模型 LFM3-1.7B 支持 256K Token 上下文，4-bit 精度下约占 1GB 内存，可在手机和笔记本上本地运行，也能通过单张 GPU 微调。新架构结合门控短卷积、滑动窗口注意力和全局注意力，预训练使用了 22 万亿 Token；模型面向本地智能体、工具调用和特定任务定制。

The official model card also specifies application boundaries: due to scale limitations, the text model is not recommended for complex multi-step reasoning or agent programming. The series uses a custom LFM Open License v1.0, and commercial use is subject to revenue thresholds. 官方模型卡同时给出适用边界：受规模限制，不推荐将文本模型用于复杂多步推理或智能体编程。系列采用自定义的 LFM Open License v1.0，商业使用受营收门槛限制。

item.title: Omdia：英国微短剧观众中，男性占 54%
item.guid: Omdia：英国微短剧观众中，男性占-54%
item.description:
Omdia's latest consumer research shows that men account for 54% of micro-drama users in the UK. Among micro-drama users in the surveyed markets, men accounted for 47%, with the US, Spain, and Brazil at 50%, 47%, and 29% respectively, showing significant regional differences. Omdia 最新消费者研究显示，男性占英国微短剧用户的 54%。在受调查市场的微短剧用户中，男性占比为 47%，美国、西班牙、巴西分别为 50%、47% 和 29%，地区差异明显。

The survey was conducted in April this year. María Rúa Aguete, Head of Media & Entertainment at Omdia, stated that the industry has long associated micro-dramas with female audiences and romance genres, potentially underestimating their reach. As the market expands, there are also growth opportunities for comedy, thriller, crime, and action genres. 这项调查于今年 4 月开展。Omdia 媒体与娱乐业务主管 María Rúa Aguete 表示，行业长期把微短剧与女性观众、爱情题材联系在一起，可能低估了它的受众范围。随着市场扩大，喜剧、惊悚、犯罪和动作题材也有增长机会。

Omdia predicts that the global micro-drama market revenue will be approximately $14 billion in 2026, approaching $25 billion by 2031. The agency believes that the next phase of growth requires understanding the audience composition in different markets and adjusting genres, marketing, and monetization strategies accordingly. Omdia 预测，2026 年全球微短剧市场收入约为 140 亿美元，到 2031 年将接近 250 亿美元。该机构认为，下一阶段的增长需要理解不同市场的受众构成，并据此调整题材、营销和变现方式。

item.title: 泡泡玛特第三季度收益同比降 45%—50%，海外市场降幅更大
item.guid: 泡泡玛特第三季度收益同比降-45%—50%，海外市场降幅更大
item.description:
Pop Mart announced its third-quarter business update on October 27th, with unaudited overall revenue decreasing by 45%-50% compared to the same period last year, with declines observed in all regions. 泡泡玛特 10 月 27 日公布第三季度业务更新，未经审核的整体收益较去年同期下降 45%—50%，各地区均出现下滑。

Specifically, revenue in the Chinese market decreased by 25%-30% year-on-year; the Asia-Pacific, Americas, Europe, and other regions decreased by 65%-70%, 70%-75%, and 50%-55% respectively. The Asia-Pacific region in the announcement does not include China. 其中，中国市场收益同比下降 25%—30%；亚太、美洲、欧洲及其他地区分别下降 65%—70%、70%—75% 和 50%—55%。公告中的亚太地区不包含中国。

Channel performance in the Chinese market also varied: offline channel revenue decreased by 5%-10% year-on-year, while online channel revenue decreased by 45%-50%. This update discloses the year-on-year revenue change range, not the net profit decline. 中国市场的渠道表现也有差异：线下渠道收益同比下降 5%—10%，线上渠道下降 45%—50%。这份更新披露的是收益同比变动区间，并非净利润降幅。

item.title: 红果已处置 20426 部低质同质化短剧，重点治理「换皮」与撞脸
item.guid: 红果已处置-20426-部低质同质化短剧，重点治理「换皮」与撞脸
item.description:
Hongguo Short Drama announced on October 27 that it has collectively disposed of a total of 20,426 micro-short dramas with low quality and homogenization issues, and will further address three types of problems: deliberate exaggeration of conflicts, homogenization of plot content, and homogenization of character materials. 红果短剧 10 月 27 日发布公告，称已集中处置存在低质和同质化问题的微短剧共 20426 部，并将进一步治理刻意渲染矛盾、剧情内容同质化及人物素材同质化三类问题。

Plot governance targets content where core settings, character relationships, key plot points, and narrative techniques are highly similar, with only local details replaced, or content that is mass 'reskinned' across series and accounts. For family, neighborhood, and workplace conflicts, the platform will also address practices that lack reasonable groundwork and character development, and mechanically stack arguments and reversals. 剧情治理针对核心设定、人物关系、关键桥段和推进手法高度相似，仅替换局部细节，或跨剧集、跨账号批量「换皮」的内容。对家庭、邻里、职场冲突，平台也将治理缺少合理铺垫和人物塑造、机械堆叠争吵与反转的做法。

Regarding character materials, the announcement specifically called out the mass application of the same face model and facial feature templates, leading to 'multiple people with the same face' and 'cross-series face clashes' where different works and characters are highly similar in face shape, makeup, and overall recognizability. The platform urges creators to stick to originality and avoid templated production. 人物素材方面，公告点名批量套用同一人脸模型、五官模板，造成不同作品与角色在脸型、妆造和整体辨识度上高度相似的「多人同脸」「跨剧撞脸」。平台呼吁创作者坚持原创，避免模板化生产。

item.title: HBO 接手开发剧版《群鸟》，《继承之战》莎拉·斯努克主演
item.guid: HBO-接手开发剧版《群鸟》，《继承之战》莎拉·斯努克主演
item.description:
HBO has secured the development project for the limited series 'The Birds,' starring 'Succession' actress Sarah Snook. Deadline reported that this adaptation was brought to market by Universal Global Television Studio this summer and has now landed at HBO. HBO 拿下限定剧《群鸟》（The Birds）开发项目，由《继承之战》演员莎拉·斯努克主演。Deadline 报道，这一改编由环球全球电视工作室在今年夏天推向市场，现已落脚 HBO。

The new version is based on the Hitchcock film and Daphne du Maurier's novel of the same name, setting the story in contemporary times and adding a murder mystery and new characters. Snook plays Myra Massey, who returns to her hometown with her daughter to escape a custody dispute, secretly investigates the disappearance of a childhood friend, and subsequently encounters a deadly bird attack connected to the case. 新版取材于希区柯克电影与达芙妮·杜穆里埃的同名小说，将故事放到当代，加入谋杀悬案与全新人物。斯努克饰演的 Myra Massey 为躲避抚养权纠纷，带女儿返回家乡，暗中调查童年好友失踪事件，随后遭遇与案件相连的致命鸟群袭击。

The pilot episode is written by Tom Spezialy, executive producer of 'Watchmen' and 'The Leftovers.' The production team also includes David Heyman from the new 'Harry Potter' series. Snook also serves as an executive producer. 试播集由《守望者》《守望尘世》执行制片人 Tom Spezialy 编剧，制片团队还包括新版《哈利·波特》剧集的 David Heyman。斯努克也担任执行制片人。
